name: effect_http_to_epub
description: Download manga chapters and build fixed-layout EPUB/KEPUB files (right-to-left, split double pages), built on Effect
author: Mael

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/bin/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:sharp --minify --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/cli.bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
